counting_rule: 30 audited capability groups, 24 mandatory; floor(100 * 14 closed / 24 mandatory)=58. Integration bucket combines IMPLEMENTED_NOT_INTEGRATED and IMPLEMENTED_NEEDS_E2E_PROOF. Gap counts count mandatory capability groups, not independent root causes or estimates of effort. Closed means certified component/operational boundary, not the entire market-to-browser product.
